fields.description: Take payments from PayPal sandbox accounts, with the Client ID and Client Secret of a sandbox app: no real money moves.
fields.label: Use Sandbox

fields.description: Of your app under Apps & Credentials in the PayPal Developer Dashboard. Sandbox and live apps each have their own Client ID and Client Secret. Without them, payments use the classic API below.
fields.label: Client ID

fields.description: The secret shown with the app's Client ID.
fields.label: Client Secret

fields.description: The ID PayPal shows for the webhook you add to your app for this site's webhook URL. Payments are then recorded even when the payer doesn't come back to the site, and Accounts Managers are told about refunds made in PayPal, reversals and disputes.
fields.label: Webhook ID

fields.description: Where payers go once they have paid, when what they paid doesn't say, e.g. /orders
fields.label: Redirect To

fields.description: PayPal's classic NVP API, from API Access in your PayPal account settings. Recurring payments use it, and one-off payments do when no Client ID and Client Secret are set.
fields.label: Classic API
